recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩個原始淋巴球，比紅血球大、核質比高、胞質只有薄薄一圈淡藍色，染色質細緻，較大者可見小核仁，無顆粒；形態符合原始淋巴球，T 細胞系需流式確認。
features: Two circulating blasts, one small and one medium-sized
High N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Round nuclei with slight indentation in the larger cell
Finely dispersed chromatin; small nucleolus in the larger cell
Background red cells normochromic; no Auer rods
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, a thin rim of agranular pale blue cytoplasm and finely dispersed chromatin; the larger cell has a slightly indented nucleus and a small nucleolus. No Auer rods or granules are seen, and the red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with circulating lymphoblasts; T-lymphoblastic leukemia requires flow cytometric confirmation of TdT and cytoplasmic CD3.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; B-lineage antigens rather than cytoplasmic CD3 establish the lineage.
Myeloblasts have more cytoplasm, more prominent nucleoli and may show granules or Auer rods with MPO positivity.
Reactive lymphocytes have condensed chromatin and abundant cytoplasm, sometimes with azurophilic granules.
